title: Scalar tensor normalization on flat K-flat representatives
statement: For a scheme W on its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], a ring-sheaf map φ : A → B, the specified scalar derived extension and exact restriction [def-weil-pbc-four-corners], and any signed-total tensor model a [def-sfb-proetale-tensor-model], let L be localization restricted to flat-term K-flat complexes. There is a natural isomorphism b : L ⋙ derivedExtension(φ) ⋙ restriction(φ) ≅ L ⋙ a.tensor(−, Q(coefficientComplex(φ))). For every flat-term K-flat P and H and every quasi-isomorphism v : H → coefficientComplex(φ), the composite a.representative(P,H), a.tensor(1,Qv), b_P inverse, and the restricted specified scalar-derived counit with its exact-restriction factorization equals Q((1_P tensor v) followed by ordinaryComplexIso(φ,P) inverse). The ordinary comparison is the original normalized one [lem-sfb-scalar-tensor-ordinary-normalization]. This asserts only the comparison on resolving representatives, with its normalization; it does not assert descent or uniqueness on the derived category.

lean.statement:
theorem representativeScalarTensorIso
    {W : Scheme.{u}}
    {A B : Sheaf (ProEt.topology W) CommRingCat.{u + 1}}
    (φ : A ⟶ B) (a : ProEtaleTensorModel W A) :
    ∃ b : ((proEtaleFlatRepresentatives W A).ι ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q) ⋙
          proEtaleRingDerivedExtension φ ⋙ (restriction φ).mapDerivedCategory ≅
        ((proEtaleFlatRepresentatives W A).ι ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q) ⋙
          (Functor.curryObj a.tensor).flip.obj
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (coefficientComplex φ)),
      ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules W A) ℤ)
        (hp : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives W A P)
        (hq : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives W A Q)
        (q : Q ⟶ coefficientComplex φ), QuasiIso q →
        a.representative.hom.app (⟨P, hp⟩, ⟨Q, hq⟩) ≫
          a.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) (DerivedCategory.Q.map q)) ≫
          b.inv.app ⟨P, hp⟩ ≫
          (restriction φ).mapDerivedCategory.map
            ((proEtaleRingDerivedExtensionCounit φ).app
              ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P)) ≫
          (restriction φ).mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app
            (((proEtaleRingExtension φ).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj
              ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P)) =
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap (𝟙 P) q
          (proEtaleOrdinaryTensor W A) (.up ℤ) ≫ (ordinaryComplexIso φ P).inv)
